claims.text: The Random Kitchen Sink (RKS) approach is used for offensive language detection by combining various features such as word vectors and applying machine learning algorithms.
RKS achieved competitive results in offensive language detection when compared to other methods like Fasttext and Google sentence encoder.
The RKS method is evaluated alongside traditional machine learning algorithms, demonstrating its effectiveness in classification tasks.
